versions.changelog:
- Skill renamed from "finance-journal" to "trademirroros".
- No functional changes; framework responsibilities, routing logic, and workspace documentation remain unchanged.

- Major reduction in codebase: 50 files related to orchestration, sync workflows, scripts, and supporting docs were removed.
- Scope narrowed to instruction-only tasks; code execution, repo sync, and credential-based features are now explicitly out of scope.
- Updated routing structure: sub-skills are now focused on journaling, memory, plan creation, review, and behavior analysis—sync and execution features are removed.
- SKILL.md reworded and simplified to clarify boundaries, responsibilities, and intended manual operations.

TradeMirrorOS is a local-first operating layer for trading memory.

It mirrors your plans, executions, mistakes, effective paths, and review loops back to you so they become durable, searchable, and reusable instead of disappearing into chat history.
